raw.rationale: Aminoglutethimide is a weak, non-selective inhibitor of steroidogenic CYP enzymes (CYP11A1, CYP19A1) and a glucocorticoid receptor antagonist, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days it lacks a potent cytotoxic mechanism that would produce lineage-selective killing in PRISM; any apparent selectivity would be rare and near baseline. Thus probabilities are very low across all lineages, with only marginal elevation for breast (CYP19A1/estrogen-dependent) and perhaps adrenal-like/steroidogenic contexts, though adrenal is not listed.
